last_commit_summary: Fixed the Phone 3D Scan Workflow to accept GLTF exports, not just GLB: a real photogrammetry app's export menu showed no GLB option, only GLTF among other formats. The importer, on-screen instructions, and status/error copy now cover both, with the error path explaining that a multi-file GLTF bundle (separate .bin/texture files) will not load, only a single embedded file or GLB.
blocker: Live Bunnings stock and pricing still require approved partner API credentials before runtime access can be enabled.
